hero.title: Never miss a janaza prayer
hero.desc: Salat Janaza notifies you in real time of funeral prayers in mosques near you. Receive the immense reward of the qirat.

hadith.text: Whoever follows a funeral procession until the prayer is offered for the deceased will receive a reward equal to one qirat, and whoever stays until the burial is completed will receive a reward equal to two qirats.

donate.title: Support Salat Janaza
donate.subtitle: Your support helps us keep the app free and ad-free
donate.why_desc: Salat Janaza is a fully volunteer community project. Every donation goes directly toward server costs, development, and improving the app so the community can continue to benefit from this service for free.
donate.hadith: "When a man dies, his deeds come to an end except for three things: sadaqa jariya (ongoing charity), knowledge which is beneficial, or a righteous child who prays for him."
donate.trust_1_desc: PayPal and Stripe encrypt your data. We do not store any banking information.
donate.trust_2_desc: Donations exclusively cover server costs and app maintenance.
donate.trust_3_desc: By supporting this project, you contribute to a chain of benefits for the entire community.
